workbench.redesignPrompt: Please redesign this popular-science image set from the current visual direction and images. The first image must be a hook that makes people tap through, and it may include a short on-image title or question. Each middle image teaches one fact, and the last image must be a CTA (comment, follow, or learn more). Keep later pictures almost text-free. Knowledge is spoken by an independent narrator, not by the characters; characters only demonstrate in the picture. Keep character continuity. Use actions: set_design plus upsert_pages with mode "replace" for a complete new text plan. Do not add generate_images this time.
workbench.chatPlaceholder: Share a popular-science idea, or type @ to add a character
workbench.defaultReply: Turned the idea into a written plan. Review each card, then generate the pictures.
workbench.agentError: Educational content design failed. Check your Poe settings and try again.
workbench.generationPausedOffline: The connection dropped, so image generation paused. You can continue the remaining images when you are back online.
workbench.generationInterrupted: The last image run did not finish. You can continue generating the remaining frames.
